 Follow Emily Ratajkowski’s NSFW Movie With Neil Patrick Harris Gets New Streaming Home
 Disheeta Maheshwari Sat, October 24, 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Image credit: Vertical Entertainment / DirecTV Cinema The psychological thriller Gone Girl, starring Ben Affleck, Rosamund Pike, Emily Ratajkowski , and Neil Patrick Harris, is heading to a new streaming platform. The David Fincher film will arrive on Paramount+ in November 2026. Its upcoming release will give subscribers another opportunity to watch the thriller based on Gillian Flynn's bestselling novel.
 Gone Girl to stream on Paramount+ next month
 Emily Ratajkowski's NSFW thriller Gone Girl is getting a new streaming home. The film will begin streaming on Paramount+ on November 1, 2026, according to the platform.
 Directed by David Fincher, Gone Girl is a psychological thriller adapted from Gillian Flynn's 2012 novel of the same name. The story begins when Nick Dunne discovers that his wife, Amy, is missing on the day of their fifth wedding anniversary. Nick alerts the authorities, but the investigation soon places him under suspicion as detectives examine the couple's relationship and question his account of the events surrounding her disappearance.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As the investigation progresses, his behavior and statements fuel doubts about his involvement, while the press turns the case into a widely followed spectacle. The search for Amy exposes the tensions beneath the couple's image and transforms Nick's life into the subject of an increasingly intense public investigation.
 The film stars Ben Affleck as Nick Dunne and Rosamund Pike as Amy Elliott Dunne. The film's supporting cast includes Neil Patrick Harris as Desi Collings, Tyler Perry as attorney Tanner Bolt, Carrie Coon as Margo "Go" Dunne, and Emily Ratajkowski as Andie Fitzgerald, among others.
 Gone Girl received favorable reviews from both critics and audiences. According to Rotten Tomatoes , the film holds an 88 percent critics' score based on 377 reviews, while its audience score is 87 percent. David Blaustein of ABC News Radio reported, "Gone Girl defies expectations. Even at its weakest moments, this movie sucks you in like a black hole."
